No Corp2Corp..!!  
 5+ years software front-end engineering experience (1+ years developing for a large system)  

 Experience building single page JavaScript applications 
 Thorough knowledge of CSS, including cross-browser issues, and use of Jquery.

 Good understanding of an asynchronous request handling, partial page updates, and AJAX 
 Can communicate and collaborate effectively with others (technical and non-technical). 
 Able to complete small-to-medium-scale projects involving other teams, with minimal guidance 
 Excellent troubleshooting skills 
 Comfortable using GIT / SVN 
 Desire to learn new things

 HTML5, CSS3 SASS, Angular.js 

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
